- All 6 components: Header (home/inner), Footer, ThemeToggle, PostList, PostCardList, PageHeader
- `docs/design/mockups/edition-option-e.html` — "The Ledger Broadsheet" rationale

**To complete Step 13:** Run the DesignSync flow in the main interactive session. When the `list_projects` call appears, approve adding the design scopes. The tool will then proceed with `create_project` ("Edition — rodmachen.com") → `finalize_plan` → `write_files`. No repo files need to be pre-created — inline `data` payloads will cover the token and component documentation.
